title: Websim gets a starting point
summary:
Community apps filled the catalog while Websim, the Elevator Challenge, and CatGPT got better ways to choose and use models.

Websim now opens to a prompt form with a model selector instead of an error. People can choose from five models, with `claude-large` as the default, before generating through the unified chat API.

The Sirius Cybernetics Elevator Challenge added Pollinations Connect and Disconnect, replacing its embedded key with each player’s key. Players can choose DeepSeek, Kimi, Gemini Fast, or Claude Fast; unrelated game updates also stop repeating floor-change messages.

CatGPT now uses a signed-in player’s key and picks an available image model, falling back to `gptimage` when needed. A follow-up preserves models specified in shared URLs and makes uploaded-image prompts pay attention to visible details. Generated memes retain their model, and the app now credits original artist Tanika Godbole.

daily.title: Choose a Websim model
daily.text: Start with a prompt and choose `claude-large`, `gemini`, `gemini-fast`, `glm`, or `kimi` before generating.

daily.title: Pick your elevator copilot
daily.text: Connect your Pollinations account to the Sirius Cybernetics Elevator Challenge and play with DeepSeek, Kimi, Gemini Fast, or Claude Fast.
